icons.name: star
icons.heading: Star
icons.description: The star is awarded and shines. Light: it gathers in, pops out with a rebound, and as it comes down from the pop five sparks flash out between its points and fade as they fly. icons.heading: Sitemap

Strong: a deeper press with a pop of the root as it sends, the links draw faster, and the child pages pop bigger and settle in two beats.

icons.name: infinity
icons.heading: Infinity
icons.description: A light runs the endless loop, for unlimited. Light: the infinity sign dims and a bright stroke traces it in one pass, through the right loop and back through the left, and as the trace closes the sign brightens and stretches a little wider before springing back. Strong: the stroke runs the loop twice, the second lap a little slower, and the sign stretches much wider and springs back in two beats as the second lap closes.

Strong: two pumps, the second smaller, with the rays flashing on each downbeat.
